statements.status_notes: The cifskey.c overflow was fixed by upstream commit 0c521d5060035da655107001374e08873ac5dde8 ("cifskey: better use snprintf()"), first released in 6.4; NVD scopes the CVE to <= 6.3. This ships upstream 7.4, whose cifskey.c uses bounded snprintf() at all three former sprintf sites. Debian's tracker still lists trixie open (urgency unimportant): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2014-2830.
